summary: Iteration 36 verifies the three GDPR follow-ups: admin consent log, GDPR data export, account-deletion guards, and the 1766 post code across the footer/policies. 12/12 backend tests pass, all UI checks pass. No functional defects found.

verifications.admin_consent_admin_only: GET /api/admin/consent returns 401 for guest, 403 for signed-in non-admin customer, 200 for admin. No customer emails leaked in refused responses.
verifications.admin_consent_shape: Panel data-testid='admin-consent' renders. Heading 'Cookie consent (1 of 68 accounts)'. Admin's own row shows chips 'Personalisation' + 'Statistics', version 2026-06-08, '25m ago'. Accounts without a record show 'not asked yet' with '—' for version and time.
verifications.fresh_customer_round_trip: New user records personalisation-only via POST /api/auth/taste — admin sees categories=['functional','personalisation'], version 2026-06-08, has_record=true. After rejectAll (cats:{}), admin sees categories=[] which the UI renders as 'refused everything optional'.
verifications.data_export_keys: GET /api/account/export returns generated_at, account, deposits, enquiries, shipments, sessions, push_devices, price_alerts, saved_search_alerts. account.email == caller's email.
verifications.data_export_no_secrets: account has no password_hash / totp / recovery_codes / webauthn_user_id. sessions have no token_hash. push_devices have no raw subscription.
verifications.data_export_private: GET /api/account/export refused for guest (401). User A's export never contains user B's email or records.
verifications.data_export_i18n: EN/BG/RO all render translated copy — no raw i18n keys like exportTitle/exportBlurb visible. BG: 'Изтегли моите данни (GDPR)'. RO: 'Descarcă datele mele (GDPR)'. Download event captured: 'my-data-2026-08-06.json'.
verifications.account_delete_guards: Wrong password → 401; wrong confirmation word → 400; correct password + 'DELETE' → account gone, subsequent login fails.
verifications.admin_delete_deposit_guard: Fabricated a paid deposit for a test user. Admin DELETE /api/admin/users/{email} refused with 400 'this customer has 1 deposit(s) that are not refunded — refund first'. After flipping payment_status→'refunded', the same DELETE returned 200. Confirms the /app/backend/server.py fix from a non-existent 'purchases' collection to 'db.deposits' with payment_status=='paid'.
verifications.post_code_1766: Present in /bg/privacy, /bg/cookies, /bg/terms, /en/privacy, /ro/privacy body text and in the footer (screenshot: 'гр. София 1766, район Витоша, ул. „Бяла река" 12, бл. 10, ап. 3, България'). Compiled JS bundle also contains '1766' and 'Бяла река'.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_user_delete guard is now correct (db.deposits + payment_status=='paid'); test confirms both refusal-on-paid and pass-on-refunded.
notify.py export drops password_hash/totp/recovery_codes/webauthn_user_id from account and token_hash from sessions and subscription from push_subscriptions — all cross-verified.

Minor: /api/admin/consent projection includes 'created_at' but the sort primary is out['recorded_at'] || out['decided_at'] which for guests-with-no-record is empty string — has_record=False rows all sink to the bottom as designed, but they end up in registration order rather than joined_at order; not a bug, just noting.
test_credentials: admin@encarskin.com / AdminTest2026! and throwaway test_* accounts registered per test (cleaned up).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test users (test_iter36_*, test_iter36_flow_*, test_iter36_wd_*) registered and torn down within the run. One fabricated deposit inserted/removed inline. No admin accounts touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Consent is written by POST /api/auth/taste (not /api/consent). Admin consent panel uses categories.length===0 → 'refused everything optional'; a real rejectAll posts cats:{} which is what the UI's Reject all button does. Deposit guard test fabricates a paid deposit directly in Mongo (motor). Backend hot-reloads, so no supervisor restart needed.
